import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long x = sc.nextLong();
        long y = sc.nextLong();
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        sc.close();

        long bestNum = 0;
        long bestDen = 1;
        long bestDiff = x;

        for (long b = 1; b <= n; ++b) {
            long aStart = Math.max(x * b / y - 10, 0);
            for (long j = 0; j < 20; ++j) {
                long a = aStart + j;
                long diff = Math.abs(x * b - a * y);
                if (bestDiff * b > diff * bestDen) {
                    bestDiff = diff;
                    bestNum = a;
                    bestDen = b;
                } else if (bestDiff * b == diff * bestDen) {
                    if (bestDen > b || (bestDen == b && bestNum > a)) {
                        bestNum = a;
                        bestDen = b;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(bestNum + "/" + bestDen);
    }
}
